title: Characterization of the ligand binding pocket of the virulence regulator Rns, a Member of the AraC/XylS family of transcription factors
authors: Jessica D Tolbert; Kacey M Talbot; F. Jon Kull; George P Munson; Charles R Midgett
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构解析和突变实验表征转录因子Rns的配体结合口袋，研究脂肪酸抑制其DNA结合，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但以湿实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅部分相关。
abstract: Diarrheal disease caused by Gram-negative enteric pathogens such as enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli (ETEC), Vibrio cholerae , Shigella spp. , and, Salmonella spp. are a leading cause of morbidity and mortality of children; especially, in low resource nations. While progress has been made in reducing this burden, there remains a need to develop efficacious therapies. Recently, we determined the structure of Rns, a member of the AraC/XylS family that regulates the expression of pili and other virulence factors in ETEC. The structure revealed decanoic acid bound between the N- and C-terminal domains. To test the hypothesis that bound decanoic acid directly inhibits Rns, we used its structure to identify residues that are necessary for ligand binding. Removal of the positive side chains of R75 and H20 rendered Rns insensitive to fatty acid inhibition. Additionally, mutations designed to occlude decanoic acid binding also produced a variant that was fatty acid insensitive. We also observed that this variant is structurally more flexible than wildtype Rns with decanoic acid; suggesting that bound fatty acid contributes to structural rigidity. These studies precisely demonstrate Rns binding pocket residues critical for binding fatty acids and inhibition of DNA binding. This supports our hypothesis that fatty acids must bind in the binding pocket to inhibit AraC regulators. Further work by us and others suggests inhibition of AraC virulence regulators by fatty acids is a common paradigm among many bacterial pathogens. Therefore, understanding the molecular basis of this inhibition lays the groundwork for the development of small molecule therapeutics targeting enteric disease.
abstract_zh: 由革兰氏阴性肠道病原体如产肠毒素大肠杆菌（ETEC）、霍乱弧菌、志贺氏菌属和沙门氏菌属引起的腹泻病是儿童发病和死亡的主要原因，尤其是在资源匮乏的国家。尽管在减轻这一负担方面已取得进展，但仍需开发有效的治疗方法。近期，我们确定了Rns的结构，Rns是AraC/XylS家族的一员，调控ETEC中菌毛及其他毒力因子的表达。该结构揭示了癸酸结合在N端和C端结构域之间。为验证结合癸酸直接抑制Rns的假设，我们利用其结构识别了配体结合所必需的残基。去除R75和H20的正电荷侧链使Rns对脂肪酸抑制不敏感。此外，设计用于阻碍癸酸结合的突变也产生了一种对脂肪酸不敏感的变体。我们还观察到，该变体在结构上比结合癸酸的野生型Rns更具灵活性，表明结合的脂肪酸有助于结构刚性。这些研究精确证明了Rns结合口袋中对于脂肪酸结合和抑制DNA结合至关重要的残基。这支持了我们的假设，即脂肪酸必须结合在结合口袋中才能抑制AraC调控因子。我们及其他人的进一步研究表明，脂肪酸抑制AraC毒力调控因子是许多细菌病原体中的常见范式。因此，理解这种抑制的分子基础为开发针对肠道疾病的小分子治疗药物奠定了基础。
